title: Bounded-fanout conversion for strict circuits
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments and exactly one argument for a NOT gate or two for an AND or OR gate. There is a circuit $C'$ on the same inputs that computes the same Boolean function, in which every gate has those same distinctness and arity properties, every vertex other than the output has positive fanout, and every vertex has fanout at most $2$; moreover, $C'$ has size at most $20$ times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate has distinct arguments and the prescribed arity
